revision_note: r5: audio re-cut at silence-bounded segment edges (RESEP-02). The old cut began 1.5 s before the singing; the new one begins at the segment edge, so every pin is shifted by -1.5 s and the first pin now sits at the 0.2 s lead margin. Pin INDICES are unchanged — the score slice did not move. Previous pins kept at pins.json.r4-pre-resep.

vs_gold.strict_on_pins_note: ingest_pins.py builds the expected delta from iv_ovr_<hymn>.json, the chanter's own interval rulings, so the reported 0.787 partly scores his answers as if they were model predictions. Unassisted (legend only) is 0.760, a gap of 2 of 75 pairs today. The gap grows mechanically as corrections are compiled, so the UNASSISTED number is the primary one.

note: The segmentation fix alone moved median |dt| 4.10 -> 0.563 s and coverage 58.7 -> 71.1%. A large excursion remains around units 3-19 (up to -5.8 s): the aligner still has no absolute-time anchor and cannot re-sync once it slips.
